title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: A position change
hook: How do you tell a player you are moving their position?
intro: The team needs them in right field.
statement: How you explain a change decides how they take it.
q1: Do you explain why the team needs them there —
q2: or make the change and see how they do?
q3: What will they hear when you tell them?
t1: Every coach is different. But changes go smoother
t2: when the player knows the reason.
cta: Coaches — how do you explain position changes?
ctaLines: Talk first. Explain the why. Try it in practice.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How do you tell a player you are moving their position?
They love playing shortstop. The team needs them in right field.
How you explain a change decides how they take it.
Explain the reason first or just make the change. There is no perfect answer.
How do you explain position changes? Share your habit in the comments.
